about_short_description.short_description: Monaqasat is an e-tendering service company that provides contracting to medium and small businesses.

product.name: E-Tendering Platform
product.description: An online platform that facilitates electronic tendering for construction projects, connecting project owners with contractors and suppliers.

product.name: Project Design Services
product.description: Comprehensive architectural, structural, and services design tailored to client requirements and budget for construction projects.

product.name: Contract Drafting and Specification Services
product.description: Preparation of legal contracts and detailed project specifications to define scope, quantities, and avoid disputes in construction projects.

product.name: Consultation and Tender Preparation Support
product.description: Engineering, technical, and contractual consultation during tender preparation to ensure project requirements and market conditions are met.

product.name: Post-Tender Project Support Services
product.description: Services after contract signing including dispute resolution, change management, payment scheduling, and project progress monitoring.

product.name: Contractor and Supplier Registration and Bidding Services
product.description: A system for contractors and suppliers to register, access project tenders, and submit bids electronically without fees.
